// diagnostic

E0936

An impl gives a constant its trait does not declare

What

An impl gives a constant its trait does not declare

Why

An implementation gives only the constants its trait declares

Fix

Remove the constant, or declare `name: Type` in the trait

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0936: tests/ui/trait_constant_undeclared_e0936.stderr.

Error [E0936]: `corners` is not a constant of `Shape`
  --> tests/ui/trait_constant_undeclared_e0936.jet:11:5
    |
 11 |     corners :: 4
    |     ^^^^^^^
 Why: An implementation gives only the constants its trait declares
 Fix: Remove `corners`, or declare `corners: Type` in `Shape`
